questions.question: The cost of tiling the floor of a rectangular room is Rs. 9100 at Rs. 65 per m². The ratio of the length and breadth of the floor is 7 ∶ 5. The perimeter (in m) of the floor of the room is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The cost of tiling the floor of a rectangular room = Rs. 9100 at Rs. 65 m²

The ratio of the length and breadth of rectangle = 7 : 5

**Formula used:**

Area of the floor of a rectangular room = Total cost/cost per square metre

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

**Calculation:**

Let the length and breadth of a rectangle be 7x and 5x respectively.

According to the question 

Area of the floor of a rectangular room = Total cost/cost per square metre

⇒ (9100/65) m²

⇒ 140 m²

Area of rectangle roomed floor= (7x × 5x)

⇒ 35x² = 140

⇒ x² = (140/35)

⇒ x² = 4

⇒ x = 2

Perimeter of rectangle roomed floor = 2(l + b)

⇒ 2(7 × 2 + 5 × 2)

⇒ 2(14 + 10)

⇒ 2 × 24

⇒ 48 m

**∴ The perimeter of the floor of the room is 48 m**

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs. 131.25, a trader gains as much percent as the number representing the cost price of the article. In order to earn 40% profit, at what price (in Rs.) should he sell the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP of an article = Rs. 131.25

Profit = 40%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (100 + Gain%)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of the article be x

A trader gains as much percent as the number representing the cost price of the article = x% [According to the question]

Now,

SP = CP × (100 + Gain%)/100

⇒ 131.25 = x × (100 + x)/100

⇒ 13125 = 100x + x²

⇒ x² + 100x – 13125 = 0

⇒ x² + 175x – 75x – 13125 = 0

⇒ x(x + 175) – 75(x + 175) = 0

⇒ (x – 75) (x + 175) = 0

⇒ x = 75 or -175

Now,

SP = CP × (100 + Gain%)/100

⇒ SP = 75 × (100 + 40%)/100

⇒ (75 × 140/100)

⇒ (15 × 7)

⇒ Rs. 105

**∴ The required SP is Rs. 105**

questions.question: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. AB and DC meet at F, when produced. AD and BC meet at E, when produced. If ∠BAD = 68° and ∠AEB = 27°, then what is the measure of ∠BFC?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral

∠BAD = 68° 

∠AEB = 27°

**Concept used:**

Sum of opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180° 

Sum of linear pair of angles of is always 180° 

Sum of all 3 interior angles of triangle is 180° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8e02feb49d138d991a32e22c9a519f89206f9c40185abf03fb2339951c47caa.png] 

∠BAE + ∠BEA + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ 68° + 27° + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ 95° + ∠ABE = 180° 

⇒ ∠ABE = (180° – 95°)

⇒ ∠ABE = 85° 

Now,

∠ABE + ∠CBF = 180° [linear pair]

⇒ 85° + ∠CBF = 180° 

⇒ ∠CBF = (180° – 85°)

⇒ ∠CBF = 95° 

Now,

∠BAE + ∠BCD = 180° [opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral]

⇒ 68° + ∠BCD = 180° 

⇒ ∠BCD = (180° – 68°)

⇒ ∠BCD = 112° 

Now,

∠BCD + ∠BCF = 180° [linear pair]

⇒ 112° + ∠BCF = 180° 

⇒ ∠BCF = (180° – 112°)

⇒ ∠BCF = 68° 

Now,

In ΔBCF

∠BCF + ∠CBF + ∠BFC = 180° 

⇒ 68° + 95° + ∠BFC = 180° 

⇒ 163° + ∠BFC = 180° 

⇒ ∠BFC = (180° – 163°)

⇒ ∠BFC = 17° 

**∴ The required value is 17° **

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 6342 is divided amongst A, B, C and D in the ratio 3 : 4 : 8 : 6. What is the difference between the shares of B and D?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total sum = Rs. 6342

The ratio = 3 : 4 : 8 : 6

**Calculation:**

Let the ratio be 3x, 4x, 8x and 6x respectively

According to the question

⇒ (3x + 4x + 8x + 6x) = Rs. 6342

⇒ 21x = Rs. 6342

⇒ x = Rs. (6342/21)

⇒ x = Rs. 302

The share of B = 4x = (4 × 302) = Rs. 1208

The share of D = 6x = (6 × 302) = Rs. 1812

The difference between the shares of B and D = Rs. (1812 – 1208)

⇒ Rs. 604

**∴ The required difference is Rs. 604**

questions.question: If 5 sin² θ - 4 cos θ - 4 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of (cot θ + cosec θ) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

**Formula used:**

sin²θ = 1 – cos²θ 

P² = (H2 – B2)

Cotθ = B/P

Cosecθ = H/P

**Calculation:**

 5sin2θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5(1 – cos²θ) – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5 – 5cos²θ – 4cosθ – 4 = 0

⇒ 5cos²θ + 4cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cos²θ + 5cosθ – cosθ – 1 = 0

⇒ 5cosθ(cosθ + 1) – 1(cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ (5cosθ – 1) (cosθ + 1) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 1/5 or -1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/514fe1bc74ce877e863a8724eef8d6f0b2a2bbd64d9cbd06a3eb8cdfb95f128b.png] 

By Pythagoras theorem

⇒ P² = (H2 – B2)

⇒ P² = (52 – 12)

⇒ P² =(25 – 1)

⇒ P² = 24

⇒ P = 2√6

Now,

Cotθ = B/P = 1/2√6

Cosecθ = H/P = 5/2√6

(cot θ + cosec θ) = (1/2√6 + 5/2√6)

⇒ (6/2√6) 

⇒ (3/√6)

Multiplying the conjugate of √6 to numerator and denominator, we get

⇒ (3/√6 × √6/√6)

⇒ ( 3√6/6)

⇒ √6/2

**∴ The required value is √6/2**

questions.question: The income of A is 20% less than the income of B and the income of C is 70% of the sum of incomes of A and B. The income of D is 25% more than the income of C. If the difference between the incomes of B and D is Rs. 23000, then what is the income (in Rs.) of A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Income of B = 100 units, then A = 80 units (20% less).

Income of C = 70% of (100 + 80) = 126 units.

Income of D = 125% of 126 = 157.5 units.

Difference (D − B) = 57.5 units → ₹23000 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹400.

Income of A = 80 × 400 = ₹32000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Income of A = Income of B − 20% of Income of B

Income of C = 70% of (Income of A + Income of B)

Income of D = Income of C + 25% of Income of C

Difference between incomes of B and D = ₹23000

 
 A = 80x
 
 
 B = 100x

 
 C = 126x
 
 
 D = 157.5x
 
 
• 
 
• 
 

 Diff = 57.5x = ₹23000

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the income of B = 100x

⇒ Income of A = 100x − 20x = 80x

⇒ Income of C = 70% of (80x + 100x) = 126x

⇒ Income of D = 126x + 25% of 126x = 157.5x

⇒ Difference between D and B = 157.5x − 100x = 57.5x

⇒ 57.5x = 23000

⇒ x = 23000 ÷ 57.5

⇒ x = 400

⇒ Income of A = 80x = 80 × 400 = 32000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹32000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base Value in Percentage

When comparing two quantities, the quantity following words like 'than' or 'of' is generally taken as the base (100%).

Successive Percentage Change

If a value is changed by A% and then by B%, the net percentage change is given by A + B + (A × B) ÷ 100.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

It is helpful to remember standard fraction equivalents, such as 20% = 1/5 and 25% = 1/4, for faster calculations.

questions.question: Suman travels from place X to Y and Rekha travels from Y to X, simultaneously. After meeting on the way, Suman and Rekha reach Y and X, in 3 hours 12 minutes and one hour 48 minutes, respectively. If the speed of Rekha is 9 km/h, then the speed (in km/h) of Suman is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time of Suman = 3 hours 12 min = (3 + 12/60) 

⇒ (3 + 1/5) = 16/5 hrs

Time of Rekha = 1 hours 48 min = (1 + 48/60)

⇒ (1 + 4/5) = 9/5 hrs

Speed of Rekha = 9 km/h

**Concept used:**

Speed of Suman/Speed of Rekha = √(Time of Rekha/Time of Suman)

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of Suman be s

According to the question

Speed of Suman/Speed of Rekha = √(Time of Rekha/Time of Suman)

⇒ s/9 = √[(9/5)/(16/5)]

⇒ s/9 = √9/16

⇒ s/9 = 3/4

⇒ 4s = (9 × 3)

⇒ 4s = 27

⇒ s = (27/4)

⇒ s = 6(3)/(4) km/h

**∴ The speed of Suman is 6(3)/(4)**

questions.question: If the 5-digit number 688xy is divisible by 3, 7 and 11, then what is the value of (5x + 3y)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

688xy is divisible by 3, 7 and 11

**Concept used:**

**Divisibility rule of 3 -** If sum of all digit of number is divisible by 3 then whole number is divisible by 3.

**Divisibility rule of 7 -** To make a pair of 3 from unit digit than subtract left over pair,

The result is divisible by 7.

**Divisibility rule of 11 -** Sum of odd digit place – Sum of even digit place = 0 or multiple of 11.

**Calculation:**

688xy is divisible by 3, 7 and 11

For divisibility rule of 3, (x + y) = 2, 5, 8, 11

For divisibility rule of 11, (6 + 8 + y) – (8 + x) = 0 or 11

⇒ (14 + y) – (8 + x) = 0 or 11

We take the value of y = 8 or x = 3

⇒ (14 + 8) – (8 + 3) = 0 or 11

⇒ (22 – 11) = 11 [divisible by 11]

So, the value of x = 3 and y = 8

Now,

(5x + 3y) = (5 × 3 + 3 × 8)

⇒ (15 + 24)

⇒ 39

**∴ The required value is 39**

 x2 – 5√2x + 1 = 0

**Calculation:**

 x2 – 5√2x + 1 = 0

⇒ x² + 1 = 5√2x

Dividing the number by x, we get

⇒ (x² + 1)/x = (5√2x)/x

⇒ x + 1/x = 5√2 

Now,

On squaring both sides, we get

We know (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ (x)² + (1/x)² + (2 × x × 1/x) = 50

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 50

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 50 – 2

⇒ x2 + 1/x² = 48

Now,

((x³+frac{1)/(x))}{x²+1}

Again dividing the given equation by x, we get

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)/(x + 1/x)

⇒ (48/5√2)

Multiplying the conjugate of √2 with numerator and denominator, we get

⇒ (48/5√2 × √2/√2)

⇒ (48√2/5 × 2)

⇒ 24√2/5

questions.question: A can complete a work in 60 days. B is 25% more efficient than A. They work together for 15 days. C alone completes the remaining work in 14 days. B and C together will complete (5)/(8)th part of the original work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to complete a work by A = 60 days

B is 25% more efficient than A 

(A + B) worked together = 15 days

Time taken to complete the remaining work by C = 14 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of A be x

B is 25% more efficient than A

⇒ (25/100)x = 1x/4

Efficient of A = 4

Efficient of B = (4 + 1) = 5

Total work = (4 × 60) = 240 units

A and B worked together for 15 days = [(5 + 4) × 15]

⇒ (9 × 15) = 135 units

Remaining work = (240 – 135) = 105 units

Time taken to complete the remaining work by C = (105/14) 

⇒ 15/2 = 7.5

Time taken by B and C to complete the 5/8th part of original work = [240/(5 + 7.5) × 5/8]

⇒ (240/12.5 × 5/8)

⇒ (6 × 2)

⇒ 12 days

**∴ The required time is 12 days**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f4bef5bb28a22720cdda54ae33dd76cebbad0653896e4140c0a748e4e8928b1.png] 

So, total efficiency of A and B = 9

In 15 days work of A + B = 9 × 15 = 135 units

Remaining (240 - 135) = 105 units will complete by C in 14 days

So, C in one day = 7.5 units

Time taken by B and C to complete the 5/8th part of original work = [240/(5 + 7.5) × 5/8] = 12 days

questions.question: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = xyz = -4, then what is the value of (x³ + y³ + z³)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = xyz = -4

**Formula used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)² – 3(xy + yz + zx)]

**Calculation:**

According to the question

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)2 – 3(xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ – 3(-4) = (1) [(1)² – 3(-4)]

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ + 12 = (1 + 12)

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + 12 = 13

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = (13 – 12)

⇒ (x3 + y3 + z3) = 1

**∴ The required value is 1**

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys an article at 30% discount on its marked price and sells it at 5% discount on its marked price. If he earns a profit of Rs. 65, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of an article at discount = 30% of MP

SP of an article at discount = 5% of MP

Profit = Rs. 65

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

**Calculation:**

Let the MP be 100

According to the question

CP of an article at discount = 30% of 100

⇒ (30/100 × 100) = 30

CP of an article = (100 – 30) = 70%

SP of an article at discount = 5% of 100

⇒ (5/100 × 100) = 5

SP of an article = 95%

Profit = (95 – 70) = 25%

According to the question

⇒ 25% = 65

⇒ 100% = [(65 × 100)25]

⇒ Rs. (65 × 4)

⇒ Rs. 260

**∴ The required MP is Rs. 260**

questions.question: A chord AB of circle C₁ of radius 17 cm touches circle C₂ which is concentric to C₁. The radius of C₂ is 8 cm. What is the length (in cm) of AB?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of C₁ = 17 cm

Radius of C₂ = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

B² = H2 – P²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/763e1169ec1cf3919cdf2e907aa426504c923132a89da77110296ec9bd51629c.png] 

According to diagram

AM² = OA2 – OM2 

⇒ AM2 = (17)2 – (8)²

⇒AM² = 289 – 64 

⇒AM² = 225

⇒ AM = 15 cm

Then,

AB = 2 × AM

⇒ AB = (2 × 15) cm

⇒ AB = 30 cm 

**∴ The required value of AB is 30 cm**

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 32.5. The average of first four numbers is 25.6 and that of the last three numbers is 38.2. The 5th number is 50% more than the 6th number and 8 less than the 7th number. What is the average of 5th and 7th numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of ten numbers = 32.5

The average of first four numbers = 25.6

The average of last three numbers = 38.2

The 5th number is 50% more than the 6th number and 8 less than the 7th number

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average of ten number = (10 × 32.5) = 325

The average of first four number = (4 × 25.6) = 102.4

The average of last three number = (3 × 38.2) = 114.6

According to the question

Let the 6th number = 2x

The 5th number = (2x + x) = 3x

The 7th number = 3x + 8 [5th number is 8 less 7th number]

Now,

⇒ (102.4 + 114.6 + 2x + 3x + 3x + 8) = 325

⇒ (225 + 8x) = 325

⇒ 8x = (325 – 225)

⇒ 8x = 100

⇒ x = (100/8)

⇒ x = 12.5

The average of 5th and 7th number = (3x + 3x + 8)/2

⇒ (6x + 8)/2

⇒ 3x + 4

⇒ (3 × 12.5 + 4)

⇒ (37.5 + 4)

⇒ 41.5

**∴ The required average is 41.5**
